    // The plane state widened to a full stress tensor by the out-of-plane normal
    // stress its idealization implies. Explicit, and taking that stress as a
    // parameter, because a plane state does not carry it.
    // Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Conversions.
    ToStressState3D(stress: StressState2D, normalZ: Pressure): StressState3D
        => StressState3D(SymmetricMatrix3x3(
            stress.NormalX.Pascals, stress.ShearXY.Pascals, 0.0,
            stress.NormalY.Pascals, 0.0,
            normalZ.Pascals));
